lines: Key; Bb Starting Note: F
Jesus died the world to save,
Then He rose up from the grave;
Forty days He spent to teach the kingdom's plan.
Told them how they'd have to wait
There inside the city's gate,
For the power God would send to save all me.
Now we have the spirit's word,
Full salvation can be heard;
Sound the message loud and clear to sinners lost.
If we put our trust in Him,
He will wash away our sins,
Just the way He did for them on Pentecost.
Well, the Spirit came down
With a rushing sound
Yes, the Spirit came down to save the lost
And to guide the minds of faithful men
Now they spoke the word of god
They'd received from up above;
Just to save the souls of men;
When the Spirit came down.
